item.title: LLMs Are Complicated Now
item.description:
📝 This is not too different from what happened with recsys. To make that work you need a fixed, usable baseline to make sure that what is generated is… right. What happened with recsys was that the gap between performance being an optimization and performance being a necessity became very, very small.
🔗 Read more: https://ianbarber.blog/2026/06/19/llms-are-complicated-now/
